title: Application profile and hardening
savedProfile: Saved. The site follows the profile's rules again.
savedRules: Saved. nginx uses the new rules now.
pathHint: One per line, relative to the document root, such as wp-content/uploads. At most {{max}}.
intro: nginx answers these requests with 404 before the site's files or PHP see them. Hidden files and folders such as <code1>.git</code1> or <code2>.env</code2> are always blocked, except <code3>/.well-known</code3>.
profileHint: The rules the site starts from. Changing it never touches the site's files or document root.
configFiles: Block database dumps, backups, logs and editor copies
suffixes: Files anywhere below the document root that end in:
denyFilesHint: One per line, such as xmlrpc.php.
noPhpDirsHint: A PHP file uploaded there never runs. One per line, such as wp-content/uploads.
limitFilesHint: At most {{perMinute}} requests per minute per address, {{burst}} more at once; then 429. One per line, such as wp-login.php.

block.hint: Read only, with the profile and rules above as they are now, saved or not. Paths below /placeholder stand for the server's own; password hashes are never shown.
block.label: Server block
